question: result.json usdcPayment.merchantDeltaYocto is 0.280610999463464400 NEAR, not the requested 0.25 NEAR. Why?
method: EXPERIMENTAL_changes account_changes for the merchant, block by block, on https://test.rpc.fastnear.com (2026-11-11).

changes.note: state before creating the USDC request
merchant signs create_request (deposit + prepaid gas reserved); the script read its 'before' balance here
+0.030610999463464400: refund to the merchant from its own create_request transaction, two blocks later
+0.250000000000000000: the Instant Pay payout, exactly the requested amount

conclusion: The payout was exactly 0.25 NEAR (also recorded by the contract: latestOperation.amountBaseUnits). The extra 0.0306 NEAR in the script's delta is the merchant's own transaction refund that landed after the script took its 'before' reading. Not an overpayment.
